This is especially true in countries like Nigeria, Venezuela, or Zimbabwe, where currency instability and platform restrictions hinder effective online commerce. Enter crypto payment gateways, a solution that allows for seamless transactions without reliance on conventional banking infrastructure. By utilizing these gateways, creators can maintain independence and maximize their profits while catering to a global audience.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack today, start by selecting a hosting service like GitHub Pages to set up your online store. Next, integrate a backend solution such as Supabase for managing orders and customer data. Incorporate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transaction processing, and ensure you configure webhook notifications for instant payment confirmation. Finally, set up a file delivery system using Google Drive, ensuring customers receive their purchased products immediately after payment. By following these steps, you can establish a fully functional online store that operates independently of traditional financial platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Pricing digital products in crypto is straightforward because NOWPayments handles the currency conversion automatically. You set your price in USD. The checkout pulls live exchange rates and displays the exact amount in whichever cryptocurrency the buyer selects. For USDT-denominated products, there is no conversion at all — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus network fees that typically amount to less than $0.10 on Tron or Solana. You receive the crypto equivalent of your USD price in the wallet you configured in your NOWPayments account. COREMERCH never touches these funds at any point — the wallet is yours from the moment of setup and remains yours unconditionally.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Save significantly on transaction fees with crypto payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This service allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, providing a seamless transaction process without the high fees associated with traditional platforms. This approach not only enhances your profit margins but ensures you can reach a global audience free from platform restrictions.
Maintain full ownership of your sales and customer data.

With instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, you can create your e-commerce infrastructure without the barriers imposed by conventional payment systems. Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up a backend solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. 3. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. 4. Configure webhook notifications for real-time payment confirmation. 5. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver purchased digital products instantly. 6. Test the entire system to ensure seamless functionality before launching.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?
You can sell an ebook online by using a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This enables you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, bypassing the need for PayPal or Stripe.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Utilizing a crypto payment gateway is the best method to sell digital downloads without platform fees. This approach minimizes transaction costs and maximizes your revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts independently by setting up your own online store with a crypto payment gateway. This allows you total control over your sales and lower fees.
What are the benefits of using a crypto payment gateway?
The benefits include lower fees, greater control over your sales process, and the ability to reach customers globally without being restricted by traditional payment platforms.
How do I ensure instant delivery of my digital products?
To ensure instant delivery, integrate automation tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script that trigger product delivery immediately upon payment confirmation.
